# Naqsh-e-Noor

> Luxury handcrafted embroidery atelier, bridal design house, and artisanal decorative hoop studio.

## Overview
[Naqsh-e-Noor](https://naqsh-e-noor.in/) is an authentic Indian Slow Craft and handcrafted embroidery atelier. We combine heritage zardozi, fine silk threads, delicate botanical needlework, and custom bridal trousseau embroidery for collectors, brides, and luxury interiors.

## Collections
- [Bridal Collection](https://naqsh-e-noor.in/#bridal): Bespoke bridal embroidery, ornate metallic thread motifs, personalized wedding date keepsakes, and traditional zardozi heirlooms.
- [Floral Collection](https://naqsh-e-noor.in/#floral): Botanical needlework capturing intricate seasonal blossoms, garden palettes, and delicate pastel petals.
- [Hoop Collection](https://naqsh-e-noor.in/#hoop): Framed artisan wall hoops on natural premium linen and solid wooden frames for wall décor and interior spaces.
- [Embroidery Collection](https://naqsh-e-noor.in/#embroidery): Celebrations of slow craft, featuring intricate thread density, geometric borders, and traditional motifs.
- [Hues Collection](https://naqsh-e-noor.in/#hues): Expressive color gradients, layered pigment work, and tonal harmony.

## Craftsmanship & Materials
- 100% slow needlework crafted by skilled artisans.
- Premium materials: raw silk, metallic zari, organic linen, and durable wooden hoops.
- Every piece is custom-tailored or produced in limited bespoke editions.

## Inquiries & Custom Commissions
- **Official Website**: [Naqsh-e-Noor Atelier](https://naqsh-e-noor.in/)
- **Orders & Direct Inquiries**: Customers can place orders, request customizations, and connect via direct WhatsApp message from the storefront.
- **Shipping**: Worldwide and pan-India shipping available.
